summary: a semicolon also starts a comment that runs to the end of the line
instruction: Change request for the A0 front end (lexer and parser): a semicolon `;` must also start a comment, exactly like `#`: everything from it to the end of the line is dropped, the newline itself stays a token. `#` comments keep working.

ret a
end

ret a
end
